 if :control_info.tech1_result = :control_info.tech2_result 
 and :control_info.tech2_result = :control_info.control_ind then

 execute_trigger('generate_results');

 (:control_info.tech2_result = :control_info.control_ind) then

 end if;

 If :SYSTEM.last_record!='TRUE' then

 Else
 null;
 End If;
 end loop;
 exit;
 end if;
 if :system.last_record!='TRUE' then 
 down;
 else
 null;
 end if; 
 END LOOP;
 end;
end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GEN_HOLD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE GEN_HOLD IS
 rg_id recordgroup;
 cl_id groupcolumn;
 ctr number(4);
 ctr2 number(4);
 temp_r_id varchar2(10); 
 exist boolean;
 cursor c1 (in_id varchar2) is
 SELECT reagent_id FROM usable_reagent_mix
 WHERE prep_reagent_id = in_id;
begin
 --Create RG
 rg_id := FIND_GROUP('PREP_REAG');
 IF not ID_NULL(rg_id) THEN
 DELETE_GROUP(rg_id);
 END IF;
 rg_id := CREATE_GROUP('PREP_REAG' ); 
 cl_id := ADD_GROUP_COLUMN('PREP_REAG','REAG_ID',CHAR_COLUMN, 10);
 -- First run of getting Reagent ID's 
 first_record;
 ctr := 0;
 loop
 ctr := ctr + 1; 
 ADD_GROUP_ROW('PREP_REAG',END_OF_GROUP);
 IF :system.cursor_block = 'REAGENT_INFO' THEN
 SET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL('PREP_REAG.REAG_ID',ctr,:reagent_info.reagent_id);
 ELSE
 SET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL('PREP_REAG.REAG_ID',ctr,:control_info.reagent_id);
 END IF; 
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 next_record;
 end loop;
 -- Subsequent run to get derived ID's
 ctr := 1;
 loop
 temp_r_id := GET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL('PREP_REAG.REAG_ID',ctr) ;
 for det in c1(temp_r_id)
 loop
 ctr2 := GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT('PREP_REAG');
 exist := FALSE;
 for i in 1..ctr2
 loop 
 IF det.reagent_id = get_group_char_cell('PREP_REAG.REAG_ID',i) 
 THEN
 exist := TRUE;
 exit;
 END IF;
 end loop;
 IF not exist THEN
 ADD_GROUP_ROW('PREP_REAG',END_OF_GROUP);
 SET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL('PREP_REAG.REAG_ID',
 GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT('PREP_REAG'),det.reagent_id);
 END IF;
 end loop; 
 exit when ctr = GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT('PREP_REAG');
 ctr := ctr + 1;
 end loop;
 for j in 1..GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT('PREP_REAG')
 loop 
 temp_r_id := GET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL('PREP_REAG.REAG_ID',j);
 UPDATE reagent_store_mst
 SET reagent_status = 'Hold' 
 WHERE reagent_id = temp_r_id
 AND expiry_date >= sysdate;
 end loop; 
 go_block('control_info');
end;
